name: How do I choose a contractor for deck structural repairs?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for deck structural repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for deck structural repairs, look for a company with a proven track record in structural work, not just cosmetic deck building. Verify their licensing and insurance, and ask for references or examples of previous structural repair projects. A reputable contractor will conduct a thorough inspection, provide a detailed estimate, and clearly explain the repair process and materials. Look for experience in your local area, such as the East Bay.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with structural repair experience, verify their license and insurance, and get a detailed estimate.
